title: Paloma and the Terminal
author: Noor Brightwater
blurb: Freya Villalobos, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
